note: S-COMMIT (INT8) governs commits authored after the Work-Integrity Codex took effect. This boundary is the first commit that repaired the gate with a decided baseline (a7132db); every commit at or before it predates enforcement and is published history that MASTER_PROMPT §8.9 forbids rewriting. The boundary commit itself must satisfy S-COMMIT, so no violating commit can ever become the boundary, and every commit newer than it is checked.
